headline: BCO Ch 21 trespass appeal hearing ordinance update, plus a Burlington Forward discussion.
summary: The committee will consider an update to the BCO Ch 21 trespass appeal hearing ordinance. It will also hold a Burlington Forward discussion and hear oral reports from the Fire and Police chiefs.
